question.text: Two soap bubbles of radii $r$ and $2 r$ are arrangement shown in the diagram. The valve is now opened. Then which one of the following will result.

options.text: The radii of the bubbles will remain unchanged
The bubbles will have equal radii
The radius of the smaller bubble will decrease and that of the bigger bubble will decrease
The radius of the smaller bubble will decrease and that of the bigger bubble will increase

solution.text:
Pressure difference $=\frac{4 T}{r}$ 
For smaller soap. $\mathrm{p_{atm}}-\mathrm{p}_{i1}=\frac{4 \mathrm{T}}{\mathrm{r}}$
For bigger soap, $\mathrm{p_{atm}}-\mathrm{p}_{i2}=\frac{4 \mathrm{T}}{2 \mathrm{r}}$
As the pressure inside smaller bubble is greater than pressure inside bigger bubble, so ar fown from smaller to bigger and thu's radius of the smaller bubble will decrease and that of the bigger bubble will increase.
